messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 502/503 rate detected for ELB target-group tg-inference-rt in eu-west-3a. 10m error rate > 8%. Auto-posting to #incidents.

maria (oncall): Im on it. Quick check: any active code pushes or config changes?

kevin (infra-sre): No deploys. Looking at ELB access logs and instance health checks. I see a surge of connection reset entries and a cluster of `target: unhealthy` events for multiple instances in eu-west-3a. Pulling ENI metrics now.

jaya (eng-runtime): Seeing elevated backend errors coming from the inference runtime logs too, but the stack traces point to abrupt connection closes, not application exceptions. Could be network drops.

maria (oncall): Tom, can you confirm if this is local to one AZ?

tom (netops): Correlating telemetry: packet drops & link flaps on a subset of fabric ports mapped to eu-west-3a. Filing cloud support ticket (case #CASE-9921). Raising provider severity.

maria (oncall): We shouldn't risk user-facing impact. Plan: 1) Shift Route53 weighted traffic away from eu-west-3a 2) Start draining ELB targets in the affected AZ 3) Increase capacity in eu-west-3b/c. Agreed?

jaya (eng-runtime): Agreed. I'll scale up ASGs in b/c and lower backend keepalive to avoid hung sockets while ENIs are unstable.

kevin (infra-sre): Updating Route53 weights now (TTL 30s) to steer ~85% away from a:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z9EXAMPLE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.example.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-west-3a","Weight":5,"TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"34.111.22.33"}]}}]}'
```
Then bumping b/c to 47/48 each. Monitoring.

kevin (infra-sre): Draining targets in tg-inference-rt for instances in eu-west-3a:
```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:eu-west-3:123456789012:targetgroup/tg-inference-rt/abcdef --targets Id=i-0f1e2d3c4b5a
```
ELB started to stop routing new connections to those instances.

ops-handoff-bot: Automatic handoff scheduled in 25m to next oncall.

maria (oncall): Observability: within 90s of weight change p95 latency dropped from 1.0s -> 320ms, 5xx rate down to ~2.2%. Still some intermittent resets shown in flow logs.

tom (netops): Provider responded: theyre seeing fabric instability tied to neighbor noisy tenants, performing per-host remediation. No firm ETA yet. Theyve quarantined a subset of network paths.

lia (cust-succ): Notifying customers in EU region. Sent initial status to affected accounts and CS channels with suggested failover steps. A few customers asked for an incident timeline.

jaya (eng-runtime): Made temporary runtime change: keepalive 60s -> 25s and reduced socket backlog to force quicker failover. ASG scale-up completed in eu-west-3b/c.

kevin (infra-sre): Note: we preserved sticky session behavior by keeping session affinity on ELB while draining; that minimized session disruption for pinned customers.

maria (oncall): Risk note: When provider remediates, ENIs might bounce and we could see reconnect storms. Prep autoscale cooldown to 600s and increase graceful termination to 120s.

jaya (eng-runtime): Applied ASG cooldown and extended SIGTERM handling. Also pushed a feature flag to prefer cross-zone targets if local ones degrade.

ops-handoff-bot: Handoff to kevin (infra-sre) at 1758525480.

kevin (infra-sre): At 1758525800 we saw a brief remediation toggle from provider causing a short spike to 4% 5xx for ~45s. No new customers reported errors in that window. Rolling logs attached to INFRA ticket.

maria (oncall): Lia: which customers actually hit 502s vs degraded latency?

lia (cust-succ): Three customers recorded 502 responses in their dashboards; five reported timeouts in user sessions; rest saw increased median latency. CS teams are applying provided failover guidance.

tom (netops): Provider reports they completed a local fix at 1758526200, but are continuing validation across eu-west-3a fabric. We're seeing ENI errors subside.

kevin (infra-sre): Restoring Route53 weights back to normal at 1758526400 after we validated target health and observed 5xx < 1% for 10m.

maria (oncall): Post-incident checklist: - confirm no lingering unhealthy targets - revoke temporary keepalive/backlog changes after stability - convert notes to postmortem and assign owners - add ENI-level early warning alerts to SRE dashboards

jaya (eng-runtime): Filing feature request to automate Route53 quick-failover playbook when AZ-local fabric errors detected.

kevin (infra-sre): Created follow-up INFRA-4892 with cloud provider case reference CASE-9921, attached ELB logs and flow logs.

maria (oncall): Customer impact summary: eu-west-3a experienced a transient networking fabric degradation leading to elevated 502/503 rates for ~40 minutes. Majority of traffic was steered away; three customers saw 502 errors, several others saw latency. No data loss, no rollback required. Incident resolved at 1758526580. Will draft postmortem and schedule runbook dry-run. :white_check_mark:
